description: Bornes de recharge pour véhicules électriques is a dataset listed in Plateforme Open Data Ville et Eurométropole de Strasbourg, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Data.gouv.fr. Extrait sur l'Eurométropole de Strasbourg du jeu de données Infrastructures de Recharge de Véhicules Electriques (IRVE) publié sur data.gouv.fr. Plus d'information sur: le jeu de données source le schéma des données. Coverage: Strasbourg Eurométropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transports. Its keywords are Strasbourg, IRVE, borne, recharge, electrique. The portal shows 1,969 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-strasbourg-eu-portal.
